prerequisite: Enemies hit by the Arbitrator or their familiar deal XX% less damage for 1 round. Does not stack.

name: Feat of Greatness
prerequisite: Despite having run out of ammunition you defended a critical area for the Arbitrators all by yourself until reinforcements arrived.

name: Illustrious Glory
prerequisite: Your words alone persuaded a group of rebels to join the Arbitrators' side in the midst of a planet-wide uprising, without any need for punitive measures.

prerequisite: Every character's melee attack reduces the target's armour by STR% until the end of combat. This reduction is applied before damage is calculated. Stacks.

name: Grievous Wounds
prerequisite:
Enemies that have 0 deflection or 0% armour against the character's attacks suffer +10% additional damage from the character.
If an enemy has both 0 deflection and 0% armour, those damage bonuses stack.

name: Psychic Awakening (Divination)
prerequisite: The character becomes an unsactioned psyker and gains +1 psy rating.

name: Critical Velocity
prerequisite: The character's critical hit chance and critical damage are increased by +5% of their dodge.

name: Deathdealer
prerequisite: Every round, after the character kills the first enemy, the character immediately makes an additional single attack against the closest enemy they can target with the same weapon if possible. This attack deals 30% base damage with a +10% bonus for every difficulty tier of the first killed enemy, i.e. if the enemy was of difficulty tier 1, this attack deals 40% damage in total.

name: Out of My Way
prerequisite:
Whenever the character pushes an enemy, the character gains +4 MP Those MP are added after the attack and allow the character to continue movement.
Damage dealt by collisions from pushes is increased by +%.

name: Contagion
prerequisite:
Whenever you apply blinded, slowed, fatigued, perplexed, or disturbed effects, one random enemy within 5 cells of the target also gains that effect for 1 round.
The same happens if you inflict stunned or prone, but the random target makes a resistance test to avoid the effect.

name: Disastrous Collision
prerequisite:
When targets pushed by the character collide with enemies or cover, both the target and the object they collide with suffer an additional +(2 x character's STR
bonus) damage.

name: Malign Influence
prerequisite: Whenever an enemy fails a Willpower resistance test against the character, they suffer (2 x character's WP bonus) direct damage. On success the damage is doubled.

name: Extermination
prerequisite: Any damage the character deals is increased by +1 for every attack they have made this combat. Does not affect damage-over-time effects: bleeding, burning, or toxin.

name: Masterful Display
prerequisite: When the character's single shots deal damage to targets other than their main target, they gain +5 Ballistic Skill until the end of combat.

name: Peak Condition
prerequisite: The character gains a bonus to their Strength equal to 20% of their maximum wounds.

name: Attention!
prerequisite: After an ally takes an extra turn provided 1 by the character, the ally gains +7% armour, +7% dodge, and +3 movement points until the end of combat. Does not stack.

name: Psychic Awakening (Biomancy)
prerequisite: The character becomes an unsanctioned psyker and gains +1 psy rating.

name: Full Attention
prerequisite: Targets that consider the character a priority target deal -40% less damage to the character's allies.

name: Combat Meditation
prerequisite: The character gains +15 Willpower as long as they have no ranged weapons equipped (staves do not count as ranged weapons).

name: Pinpoint Accuracy
prerequisite: The character ignores (BS bonus / 2) of the enemy's deflection (rounded down).

name: Shot Through
prerequisite: The character's attacks gain an additional +(BS / 2)% overpenetration. Their overpenetration attacks cannot be dodged.

name: Puncture
prerequisite: If the character's armour penetration is higher than the enemy's armour, the character's critical hit chance against that enemy is increased by +2% for every 5% difference between the character's armour penetration and the enemy's armour.

name: Degraded Defence
prerequisite: Whenever the character deals damage to an enemy, that enemy suffers +1 stack of the degraded defence effect for every 6 damage that the character has dealt. Whenever an ally attacks that enemy, they deal additional damage equal to the number of degraded defence stacks.

name: Eager for Battle
prerequisite: During the first turn of combat, the character has +2 additional action points.

name: Perfection Under Fire
prerequisite: The character gains +5 to all characteristics. This bonus is doubled when they have 25% wounds or less

name: Tricky Defence
prerequisite: As long as the character wears light armour, their dodge is increased by half of the armour bonus of that armour.

name: Know-It-All
prerequisite: The character gains a +(2 + INT bonus / 2)% bonus to armour, armour penetration, dodge, dodge reduction, critical hit chance, critical damage, and parry chance.

name: Psychic Awakening (Sanctic Powers)
prerequisite:
The character becomes an unsanctioned psyker and gains +1 psy rating.
Deals (from (1 + psyker's WP Bonus x psy rating) to (4 + psyker's WP Bonus x (1 + psy rating))) damage to the target.

name: Firebrand
prerequisite: If an extra turn given by the character's abilities or talents grants MP, the target gains +4 additional MP; if AP - the target gains +1 additional AP.

name: Psychic Awakening (Pyromancy)
prerequisite: The character becomes an unsanctioned psyker and gains +1 psy rating.

name: Lethal Threat
prerequisite: Enemies hit by the character with a melee attack must pass a Willpower resistance test or make the character their priority target until the start of the character's next turn.

name: Unbreakable Will
prerequisite: The character gains a bonus to all resistance tests equal to +(5 x deflection).

name: Deadly Aim
prerequisite: If the character's dodge reduction is higher than the enemy's dodge, the character's damage against that enemy is increased by +1% for every 5% difference between the character's dodge reduction and the enemy's dodge.

name: Unstoppable
prerequisite: The character becomes immune to all effects that reduce their MP. They gain +(TGH bonus / 2) MP.

name: Vital Points
prerequisite: Whenever the character scores a critical hit, thtey have a chance to increase their critical damage bonus by half. That chance is equal to (character's critical chance - 50)% (minumum of 0%).

name: Tipping Point
prerequisite: The character's dodge reduction and armour penetration are increased by +10% of their critical hit chance.

name: Acceleration Protocols
prerequisite: Pasqal gains 4 MP in the first round of combat. Every successful melee attack grants Pasqal +(INT bonus / 2) MP for the next round.

name: Aiming Protocols
prerequisite: Pasqal gains +(5+INT) to Ballistic Skill and a +(10+INT)% to dodge reduction with plasma and melta weapon ranged attacks.

name: Close-up Scanning
prerequisite: Pasqal's melee attacks apply the machine spirit communion effect on all attacked enemies.

name: Exposing Communion
prerequisite: Pasqal's attacks and effects of the Expose Weakness ability gain bonuses against enemies under the effects machine spirit communion, as if those enemies had 2 more stacks of exploit.

name: Filtering Protocols
prerequisite: When Pasqal uses plasma or melta weapons the first time in a round, he gains a +1 AP.

name: Machine Spirit Scan Protocols
prerequisite: Machine Spirit Communion applies 1 stack of exploit on all affected enemies.

name: Manipulator Push
prerequisite: Manipulator mechadendrite attacks enemies in close combat, pushing them up to 2 cells away and dealing (WS + INT bonus) damage. This attack has (5 x Tech-Priest's PER bonus)% armour penetration.

name: Medicae Mechadendrite
prerequisite:
The Tech-Priest can use their mechadendrite to restore the wounds of an ally once per combat.
The ally against (6 + Medicae / 5) wounds.

name: Overcharge Protocols
prerequisite: Every time Pasqal uses plasma or melta weapons, his damage with these weapons increases by (5+INT)%. Stacks. If Pasqal does not shoot for 1 round, he loses all stacks.

name: Predictions Protocols
prerequisite: Pasqal gains a +(15+INT)% to dodge reduction and parry reduction with melee weapons. If an enemy dodges or parries his attack, the bonus is doubled for the next melee attack against this enemy.

name: Skirmish Protocols
prerequisite: While Pasqal is under the effects of machine spirit communion, his melee attacks deal an additional +(10+INT)% damage and gain (10+INT)% armour penetration.

name: Champion of the Abyss
prerequisite: Permanent +2 bonus to Weapon Skill Tests and +5 bonus to Coercion Tests.

name: Champion of the Darkness
prerequisite: Grants the ability to improve their Lore (Xenos) skill even if their background or archetype does not allow it. +5 to Willpower.

name: Curse of the Abyss
prerequisite: Permanent -5 penalty to Willpower tests.

name: Blade in His Hand
prerequisite: Any Bladedancer attacks made with a sword deal + AGI bonus% additional damage. This bonus damage is doubled if using a two-handed sword.

name: Blood Bonds
prerequisite: Every ally targeted by Oath of Vengeance gains the same bonuses as the Bladedancer against all affected enemies.

name: Death Warden
prerequisite: The Bladedancer's Medicae is now determined by Weapon Skill instead of Intelligence (if their Weapon Skill is higher). The Bladedancer deals + (5 + Medicae / 10)% critical damage and can use medikits as if having Medicae skill advancement or the corresponding feature or talent.

name: Blinding Blades
prerequisite: Enemies attacked by the Bladedancer have their weapon Skill, Ballistic Skill, and Perception reduced by -(10 + Bladedancer's WS bonus) until the start of the Bladedancer's next turn. These penalties do not stack.

name: Race Against Death
prerequisite: The Bladedancer's maximum wounds are increased by +(Bladedancer's dodge/10).

name: Rising Tempo
prerequisite: Each attack made by the Bladedancer increases the damage of all subsequent attacks they make this turn by +5%. This effect stacks up to 3 times. Area attacks, burst attacks (including the Blade Dance), and any other attacks that deal multiple hits are considered single attacks.

name: Steady Hand
prerequisite: The Bladedancer's parry is increased by +TGH bonus%. An attacker's melee critical hit chance bonus determined by the difference between the attacker's and the Bladedancer's Weapon Skill characteristic is halved.

name: Sweeping Motions
prerequisite: The Bladedancer's melee area attacks cost -1 AP less (but not less than 1).

name: Anticipation
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer parries a melee attack while under the effect of Veil of Blades, they deal 50% of ther normal damage to the attack. Additionally, while under the effect of Veil of Blades, the bladedancer's chance to deflect a ranged attack at an enemy is increased by +20%.

name: Balancing on the Edge
prerequisite: The Bladedancer can use both a desperate measure and a heroic act in the same combat (but not in the same round). Whenever the blade dancer uses a desperate measure, they gain +10 Weapon Skill and +3 resolve.

name: Blessed Scars
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer is healed for the first time in a round, they are healed for an additional +TGH bonus wounds and gain +10 Toughness until the end of combat. Stacks.

name: Blood Rush
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer uses an ability that costs wounds, they gain +3 MP in the current turn.

name: Bloody Requiem
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer kills an enemy, the Bladedancer's resolve is increased by +1 until the end of combat.

name: Dance Partners
prerequisite: As long as the Bladedancer has two swords equipped, the Bladedancer's Weapon Skill is increased by +AGI bonus.

name: Duellist
prerequisite: The Bladedancer deals an additional +(5 + Bladedancer's WS bonus)% damage against enemies armed with a melee weapon.

name: Escape Artist
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer dodges an attack made by an enemy who attacks them for the first time, the Bladedancer gains +1 charge of Death From Above.

name: Facing the End
prerequisite: The Bladedancer gains +3 Weapon Skill and +3 Agility for every injury they are currently suffering and +10 Weapon Skill and +10 Agility for every trauma.

name: Feel No Pain
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer uses an ability that costs wounds, they gain half of the wounds spent as temporary wounds. The number of temporary wounds gained cannot be decreased by effects that reduce the cost of abilities.

name: Grand Performance
prerequisite: Targets affected by Captive Audience have their armour, dodge, and parry reduced by -(10 + AGI bonus)% until the end of combat. This penalty is doubled for targets failing the ability's Toughness resistance test.

name: Guillotine
prerequisite: Death From Above deals double damage to enemies that have less than 50% wounds.

name: In Footsteps of Death
prerequisite: Every time an enemy is killed by Blade Dancer's allies, the amount of Movement Points Blade Dancer gets on their next turn increases by 2.

name: It Takes Two
prerequisite: If all the strikes made as part of Blade Dance are directed against the same target, the last strike deals double damage.

name: Killing Rhythm
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer kills an enemy with an attack of opportunity, the Bladedancer immediately gains +1 charge of Death From Above.

name: Paid in Blood
prerequisite: Once the Bladedancer has killed four enemies in total, the next ability which requires spending wounds will cost no wounds and instead restore (5 + 2 x TGH bonus) wounds.

name: Promises of Blood
prerequisite: Blood Oath restores an additional +1 AP.

name: Shadow Dancer
prerequisite:
As long as the Bladedancer has less than 50% wounds, they gain +12% dodge and +3 MP.
The Bladedancer also gains +8% dodge and +2 MP for every unconscious ally in combat.

name: Slip Away
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer uses Acrobatic Artistry, their dodge and cover efficiency are increased by +(5 + AGI bonus)% until the end of their next turn. This bonus is doubled against all attacks made by enemies during the Bladedancer's turn (including extra turns).

name: Spinning Blades
prerequisite: Whenever the Bladedancer parries an attack, the number of attacks made by the next Blade Dance is increased by +1. This effect stacks up to AGI bonus times.

name: Unforgiving
prerequisite: After the Bladedancer loses any number of wounds, their next attack deals +(5+TGH bonus)% more damage. If that loss causes the Bladedancer to suffer an injury or trauma, the bonus damage increases to +(10+2 x TGH bonus)%.

name: Forced Repentance
prerequisite:
Whenever the Executioner inflicts a damage-over-time effect on a target already suffering from an effect of the same type, that target must make the relevant resistance test required to remove that effect with a penalty equal to -(Executioner's Medicae / 10). If failed:
The target immediately suffers an additional instance of damage from the initial effect.
All damage-over-time effects of this type on the target (including the one just inflicted and the ones that will possibly be inflicted later) have their level increased by (Medicae/15). This bonus stacks.

name: Where It Hurts
prerequisite:
If the target of the Executioner's next successful attack is suffering any damage-over-time effects, for each effect it must make the relevant resistance test required to remove it with a penalty equal to -(Executioner's Medicae / 10). If failed:
The target immediately suffers 3 instances of damage from that effect (2 if it is a burst or area attack). This damage is dealt after all other effects from the attack are applied.
The damage-over-time effect is removed from the target.
Until the end of the round, the target cannot be affected by damage-over-time effects of the same type.
This ability is applied instead of Scourging Strikes and removes all stacks of Forced Repentance.

name: Scourging Strikes
prerequisite: The Executioner's melee attacks inflict (PER bonus + STR bonus) levels of bleeding on all targets hit. This effect is applied after all other effects from the attack are applied.

name: Acute Pain
prerequisite: Whenever an enemy suffers damage from a damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner for the first time in combat, this damage is increased by +100%.

name: All-Encompassing Agony
prerequisite: If an enemy suffering from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects is suffering from bleeding, burning (including the effects inflicted by a pyromancer or a Navigator), and toxin (including the effects inflicted by a biomancer) at the same time, all of these damage-over-time effects deal +30% more damage to that enemy.

name: Anatomy Expert
prerequisite: The maximum number of wounds for the Executioner depends on their Medicae instead of Toughness.

name: Battle of Attrition
prerequisite: At the start of each round, all enemies suffering from any damage-over-time effects inflicted by the Executioner have their incoming damage-over-time from any source increased by +20%. Stacks.

name: Bleeding Stigmata
prerequisite: Targets of Exsanguination are also immune to toxin and burning while suffering from bleeding.

name: Bloody Trail
prerequisite: While moving, all bleeding enemies leave a bloody trail on the ground which remains for 1 round. Moving through these bloodstained cells costs the Executioner 0 MP.

name: Death in the Air
prerequisite: Whenever an enemy suffering from toxin inflicted by the Executioner dies, all enemies in a 2-cell radius around that enemy suffer (INT bonus) levels of toxin.

name: Death Warrant
prerequisite: The level of the damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner's Merciless Verdict is increased by +(maximum weapon damage / 5).

name: Deep Laceration
prerequisite: When using Scourging Strikes, the Executioner's melee critical hits inflict (3 x STR bonus) levels of bleeding on their targets instead of (2 x STR bonus) levels.

name: Does it Hurt?
prerequisite: All damage-over-time effects inflicted by the Executioner gain a 20% critical hit chance. This chance is increased by all bonuses to critical hit chance.

name: Everlasting Agony
prerequisite: The duration of negative effects inflicted by Pain Resonance is increased by +1 round, and the penalty to the corresponding resistance tests is increased to — (20 + medicae/5).

name: Fragile Playthings
prerequisite: The first instance of damage dealt by the Executioner's damage-over-time effects in around reduces the inflicted enemy's armour by — (10 + INT bonus)% until the end of combat. This effect can be inflicted on multiple enemies per round, but only once per enemy. Stacks.

name: Hardened Body
prerequisite: Whenever the Executioner or their party members are suffering from any damage-over-time effects, these effects deal only 50% of their damage. Stacks multiplicatively (50% damage if there is one Executioner with this talent in the party, 25% damage if there are two Executioners with this talent in the party, etc.)

name: Internal Bleeding
prerequisite: When pushing an enemy, the Executioner also inflicts (Medicae/10) levels of bleeding on that enemy.

name: Invigorating Screams
prerequisite: Whenever an enemy in a 4-cell radius around the Executioner suffers damage from a damage-over-time effect, the Executioner regains + (TGH bonus/2) wounds.

name: Maddening Flames
prerequisite: At the start of their turn, an enemy suffering from burning inflicted by the Executioner must make a Willpower resistance test. If failed, burning is removed and the enemy falls prone until the start of their next turn.

name: Master of Torture
prerequisite: The Executioner deals +5% more damage to a target for each type of damage-over- time effect inflicted on that target.

name: Perfect Anatomy
prerequisite: The Executioner's armour is increased by + (5 + maximum wounds/20)%.

name: Racking Weakness
prerequisite: The damage dealt by the Executioner's damage-over-time effects is increased by (medicae / 20)% for every -10% penalty to armour suffered by the target from any source.

name: Reprieve
prerequisite: If the Executioner used Reckless Abandon in the previous round and, by the start of their turn, still has temporary wounds, they are healed for + (15% of maximum wounds) wounds.

name: Revelling in Suffering
prerequisite: Each adjacent creature counts as two for the purpose of calculating the bonuses granted by Gift of Torment.

name: Sickening Pain
prerequisite: Whenever a single instance of damage from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects deals damage equal to or more than 10% of the enemy's maximum wounds, that enemy gains +1 stack of fatigued.

name: Sower of Distress
prerequisite: Enemies suffering from any damage-over-time effect inflicted by the Executioner also suffer a — (5 + Medicae/20) penalty to their resistance tests.

name: Tormenting Sprain
prerequisite: Whenever an enemy suffering from any of the Executioner's damage-over-time effects dodges the Executioner's attack, all damage-over-time effects currently inflicted on that enemy now deal an additional +10% damage. Stacks.

name: Unbearable Presence
prerequisite: Targets of Terrifying Strike now make a Willpower resistance test with a - (10 + 2 x STR bonus) penalty. If failed, they provoke attacks of opportunity from the Executioner's allies during the forced movement.

name: Vivisection
prerequisite: The Executioner gains a + (Medicae/5) bonus to Lore (Xenos).

name: Pulse Amplifier
prerequisite: Pasqal's arc rifle shots gain + (INT / 3)% dodge reduction against primary and secondary targets.

name: Thriving in Peril
prerequisite: Every perils of the warp increases momentum by +(psyker's WP bonus + resolve + psy rating).

name: Power Conduit
prerequisite: After triggering psychic phenomena or perils of the warp first time each turn, the psyker's next psychic power costs -1 less action point.

name: Advice and Guidance
prerequisite: The first time in combat that an ally becomes the target of the psyker's psychic power, this ally gains +10 to Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill until end of combat.

name: Crimson Tide
prerequisite: A creature with the bloodblessed or bloodstained effect gains +1 stacks of this effect whenever raining blood is inflicted again or whenever a turn starts on a blood covered cell.

name: Dance of Blood
prerequisite: Death Cult Assassin's allies deal (2 + AGI bonus)% more damage to enemies if both the ally and their target stand on the blood covered cells.

name: Dance of Thorns
prerequisite: Each time the Death Cult Assassin parries or dodges an attack, all enemies with the bloodstained effect suffer +1 stack of this effect.

name: Open the Veins
prerequisite: A creature with the bloodblessed or bloodstained effect gains +1 stack of this effect whenever bleed, burning or toxin is inflicted on it.

name: Wounds Streaming Blood
prerequisite: A creature with the bloodblessed or bloodstained effect gains +1 stack of this effect whenever it suffers damage from bleed, burning or toxin.

name: Asuryani Outcast
prerequisite: At the start of her next turn (excluding extra turns), if possible, she makes an attack that cannot miss and does not count toward the attack limit per turn.

name: Path of the Outcast
prerequisite: When Yrliet kills a target with a single shot attack from aeldari weapon for the first time in a round, she immediately gains an additional attack.

name: Penetrating Sight
prerequisite: In My Sights gains additional armour penetration equal to PER%.

name: Prescient Sight
prerequisite: In My Sights gains additional dodge reduction equal to Ballistic Skill%.

name: Swift Sight
prerequisite: In My Sights costs only 1 AP.

name: Kabalite Dracon
prerequisite: Deals STR bonus rending damage to Marazhai and he starts bleeding. While Marazhai is bleeding, he gains +3 Resolve.

name: Emboldened by Bloodshed
prerequisite: While Marazhai is bleeding, his fellowship and willpower are increased by +15.

name: Mantle of Agony
prerequisite: While bleeding, Marazhai gains +(3 x TGH Bonus)% additional armour.

name: Prey on the Weak
prerequisite: While Marazhai is bleeding, every kill he makes grants him a stacking +5 bonus to weapon skill and ballistic skill.

name: Trueborn Superiority
prerequisite: When Marazhai makes an additional attack granted by Dual-weapon combat, using a drukhari weapon, that attack suffers no penalties and does not have its cost increased.

name: Aeldari Equipment
prerequisite: Able to equip Aeldari armour.

name: Point of Interest
prerequisite: All Combat Tactics bonuses are increased by +((INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% if the area was not moved for 2 rounds.

name: Diversion Zone
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Rear area also makes the allies in that area the enemies' lowest priority targets for 1 round.

name: Crossfire Zone
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Frontline area grants allies in the area +(10 + 2 x (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus))% increased dodge against other allies' hattacks.

name: Enduring Zone
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area grants all allies in the area +INT bonus deflection against the next melee hit they suffer.

name: Redeployment
prerequisite: Every time a Combat Tactics area is affected by a stratagem, all allies in that area gain +1 MP for the following turn. Stacks with itself.

name: Adjusting Frontline
prerequisite:
If there are more enemies than allies in the Frontline area, all allies in the area gain +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% to parry and dodge.
If there are more allies than enemies in the Frontline area, all allies in the area deal +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% damage.

name: Personal Zone
prerequisite: Allies, including the Grand Strategist, in the same Combat Tactics area with the Grand Strategist gain +(3 + INT bonus / 2) Perception and Agility.

name: Strongpoint
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area for the second time in a turn refunds 1 AP. This effect can be activated once per turn.

name: Personal Combat Zone
prerequisite: Allies gain the ability to reposition the Combat Tactics area they are currently at the cost of 1 AP.

name: Critical Zone
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Backline area grants allies in the area +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% increased critical hit chance against enemies they are protected by cover from.

name: Mobility Zone
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area grants all allies in the area the ability to move 1 cell without provoking attacks of opportunity.

name: Supporting Zone
prerequisite: Using a stratagem on a Combat Tactics area grants the Grand Strategist the ability to use all Officer abilities on allies in the area regardless of distance.

name: Strategic Perfection
prerequisite: Each time the Grand Strategist uses a stratagem, they gain a stack of the strategic perfection effect. At 6 stacks of strategic perfection, the next stratagem applies the benefits of all stratagems known by the Grand Strategist, then all the stacks are removed.

name: Improvised Strategy
prerequisite: At the start of combat, the Grand Strategist gains one random unknown stratagem and can use it until the end of combat for 0 AP.

name: Sniping Zone
prerequisite: Each ally in the Rear area gains +(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% critical hit chance if there are no enemies in a 5-cell radius around the ally.

name: Fire at Will
prerequisite: If there are no enemies in the Backline area, the first attack in the turn made by every ally in that area costs -1 AP less.

name: Disputed Zone
prerequisite: Enemies in the same Combat Tactics area with the Grand Strategist suffer a -(3 + (Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) / 2)% penalty to dodge and parry.

name: Strategic Offensive
prerequisite: Every enemy killed in the Frontline area increases all bonuses of Combat Tactics areas by +1 until the end of combat.

name: Respite Zone
prerequisite:
All allies in the Rear area are healed by medikits for +(5 + Grand Strategist's INT + FEL bonus) more and gain the same amount of temporary wounds.
Medikits used by allies in the Rear area toost -1 AP less.

name: Inescapable Zone
prerequisite: Re-rolls forced by Killzone Stratagem are made with a -15 penalty.

name: Fortress Zone
prerequisite: Allies under the effects of Trenchline Stratagem will dodge area attacks without movement and are immune to all types of forced movement.

name: Daunting Zone
prerequisite: Willpower resistance tests forced by Overwhelming Stratagem are made with a -(5 + 2 X (INT + FEL bonus)) penalty.

name: Opening Strategy
prerequisite: The first stratagem used in a turn can be used a second time for 0 AP.

name: Overcoming Zone
prerequisite: Every time allies under the effect of Stronghold Stratagem should have suffered an injury, they gain +(INT + FEL bonus) temporary wounds instead.

name: Blurred Locus
prerequisite: After the use of Combat Locus Stratagem, one of the areas removed by Combat Locus Stratagem can be recreated immediately.

name: Hidden Advantage
prerequisite: All the Master Tactician's abilities work as if the Master Tactician has FEL bonus more stacks of tactical advantage.

name: Joint Offensive
prerequisite: For every enemy hit by the Master Tactician's attack, the Master Tactician gains +1 stack of tactical advantage.

name: Nerves of Steel
prerequisite: Whenever the Master Tactician or their allies gain momentum, they gain +1 more. Whenever the Master Tactician or their allies lose momentum, they lose -1 less.

name: Suppressive Fire
prerequisite: All enemies hit by the Master Tactician have +10% higher chances of hitting a cover when shooting at the Maste Tactician's allies behind a cover.

name: Against All Odds
prerequisite: The Master Tactician begins combat with additional stacks of tactical advantage equal to the number of enemies.

name: Brink of Death
prerequisite: The Master Tactician deals +12% more damage to targets with less than 50% wounds and heals +20% more wounds for targets with less than 50% wounds.

name: Reliance
prerequisite: Using Linchpin now spends only 1/4 of tactical advantage stacks instead of 1/2.

name: In the Hero's Footsteps
prerequisite: Whenever the Master Tactician's ally uses a heroic act, the Master Tactician gains +5 Fellowship. Whenever their ally uses a desperate measure, the Master Tactician gains +5 Toughness. These bonuses stack and last until the end of combat.

name: Personal Involvement
prerequisite: Every enemy killed by the Master Tactician increases the Master Tactician's resolve by +1 until the end of combat.

name: Salvation
prerequisite: Using medikits on an ally under the effects of the Master Tactician's archetype abilities heals that target for additional wounds equal to (Master Tactician's FEL bonus + target's TGH bonus) and removes an extra injury wit out any tests.

name: Tactical Respite
prerequisite: Whenever the Master Tactician reloads a weapon, all allies within a 3-cell radius around the Master Tactician also reload their weapons.

name: Cost-Effective
prerequisite: Grenades and medikits cost -1 less action point to use (minimum 0).

name: Stand Resolute
prerequisite: Whenever the Master Tactician heals an ally, that ally gains +1 resolve until the end of combat. This effect stacks up to a maximum of +FEL bonus.

name: Ally Coordination
prerequisite: All allies have +25% dodge against attacks made by allies, deal -25% less damage to allies, and deal -50% less additional damage with critical hits against allies.

name: Undisputed Advantage
prerequisite: Press the Advantage ignores cover and dodge.

name: Heroic Inspiration
prerequisite: The first ability the Master Tactician uses after the very first heroic act used in combat will cost 0 action points until the end of combat.

name: Logistical Superiority
prerequisite: Whenever the Master Tactician or the Master Tactician's ally uses any consumable item (e.g., grenade, medikit, etc.) or reloads a weapon, the Master Tactician gains +2 stacks of tactical advantage.

name: Comfort in Conformity
prerequisite: Whenever an ally grants the Master Tactician stacks of tactical advantage, that ally also heals 1 wound for every stack granted.

name: Stacking the Deck
prerequisite: Whenever the Master Tactician spends tactical advantage stacks on abilities, the critical damage dealt by the Master Tactician increases by +1% for every stack spent until the end of the turn.

name: Dawn of Victory
prerequisite: Every critical hit scored by the Master Tactician grants them momentum equal to (resolve / 2). Works up to 3 times per turn.

name: Unwavering Motivation
prerequisite: The target of Inspire gains +1 additional damage for every 10 stacks of tactical advantage until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn.

name: Primary Objective
prerequisite: Assign Objective also makes the target suffer +7% more damage from any source until the beginning of the Master Tactician's next turn.

name: Stronghold
prerequisite: Strongpoint also grants half the amount of temporary wounds to the ally closest to the target.

name: Perfect Finish
prerequisite: Finish the Job gains +75% critical hit chance.

name: Persistence of the Forge
prerequisite:
Forge world characters gain a stacking +10% bonus to hit chance and dodge reduction against any target they hit with a single-target attack.
Successful critical hits from single-target attacks increase the hit chance and dodge reduction by +20%.

name: Weapon Personalization
prerequisite: All ranged weapons dealing physical damage have +1 damage, +1% armour penetration, +1 rate of fire, and -5 to recoil.

name: Shearing Strikes
prerequisite: When the Warrior uses Slash with two melee weapons equipped, the Warrior deals damage from both weapons.

name: Easy Target
prerequisite: The Warrior's critical damage is increased by +(10 + 2 × STRbonus)% against enemies not armed with a melee weapon.

name: Demolition Engineer
prerequisite: The Soldier's Demolition instead of Intelligence is used to determine additional damage dealt with ranged area attacks. Deals 5% more damage for every 10 points in Demolition (instead of 5% for each 10 points of Intelligence).

name: Weapon Specialist
prerequisite: Sweep attack of the axes and Shove attack of the maces and hammers cost 1 less action point.
